notes.body: Hi @martin.r.mathieson for some case (like bgp) the same field is using with multiple length, what the better fix ?

@alagoutte I think when the same field appears with different lengths, this is fine if the length of the item matches the longest call.

I'm only picking off cases at the moment where the length in the call is longer than the type of the item implies (which is what check_typed_item_calls.py currently reports).

These all look fine to me.  I think that the ones where the item length is longer are harmless, but when the item length is shorter than the call I assume filtering on that field may not work probably.

Having said that, I have seen cases where the field has VALS() where the highest entry in the value_string fitted into the item length, so it should work as expected.

The calls at lines 3015 and 3016 both cover the same bytes as the message type.  They show different ways of looking at the message type field?

You are the author of this dissector :)
Looks like you missed checking the box to allow other core devs to change the MR.
i will check the spec but i think, there is a 3 bytes for enterprise number and 1 bytes for type..
@alagoutte, did you manage to look up the capwap thing?  I think I accidentally fixed at least part of the packet-dns.c change in a separate MR...

i don't found capture with this field...
i think, we can merge like this and fix after if needed !
You can't merge until you have ✅ Allow commits from members who can merge to the target branch selected and threads are resolved.
I resolved the threads for you.
